title: terebinthus microphylla
intro: Terebinthus microphylla, commonly known as the dwarf sumac, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the Anacardiaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Terebinthus microphylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Terebinthus microphylla for medicinal purposes.
